title: vernonia cinerea subsp. vialis
intro: Vernonia cinerea subsp. vialis, commonly known as the 'Rough Ironweed', is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia cinerea subsp. vialis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
